Due to the significant differences in data across the different counties, here are some insights bout those data differences: 

Only 24 of the 87 counties have public databases of their parcel information. 

Of those, only 19 contain any information besides address and owner name.

Ramsey County contains the most additional information with 119 data columns. 
Clearwater contains the least with only 8.

Olmsted County has the most recent data with their database being updated in early 2026, while cook has the oldest being updated in 2022. 

Within those 24 counties there are: 20 different ways to say owner name, 22 different ways to specify address, 5 different ways to specify ArcGIS parcel geometry, and 4 different ways to specify parcel ID.
